Note 1: BCP Topco IX Pte. Ltd. has created a pledge over its entire shareholding in the Company in favour of Catalyst Trusteeship Limited (as the Onshore Security Agent) and has agreed to certain covenants in the nature of encumbrance in favour of Deutsche Bank AG, Singapore Branch (as the Agent), DB International Trust (Singapore) Limited (as the Offshore Security Agent) and Catalyst Trusteeship Limited (as the Onshore Security Agent), for the benefit of the relevant lenders under the Facility Agreement dated May 12, 2026, to secure a term loan facility availed by BCP Topco IX Pte. The relevant disclosures in terms of Regulation 31 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 were initially made on 19 May 2026 and subsequently made on 26 May 2026.

Note 2: Sun Yiming, who is the director of BCP Topco IX Pte. Ltd., is the designated Significant Beneficial Owner (SBO) with respect to the shares held by BCP Topco IX Pte. Ltd. in accordance with the Companies (Significant Beneficial Owners) Rules, 2018. The SBO has redacted the passport details as it is sensitive personal information. In case the stock exchanges requires the passport number of the SBO in future, the passport number will be provided by the SBO.
